resources.string: Keeps sharing active in the background so you can earn. Tap to open BusyProxy.

When sharing is on, authorized BusyProxy clients may route internet traffic through your phone’s selected network (Wi‑Fi or mobile). You can stop anytime. We never show you proxy passwords — operators manage access separately. You earn per GB shared. By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy at busyproxy.net/terms and busyproxy.net/privacy. You can delete your account anytime in the app or at busyproxy.net/account-deletion.
